query:
SELECT event_id AS "event_id!", txn_id FROM (
                   SELECT COALESCE(result->>'event_id',
                                   substring(result_text from '"event_id":"([^"]+)"')) AS event_id,
                          txn_id
                   FROM transactions WHERE scope = 'client' AND owner = $1
               ) t WHERE event_id = ANY($2)
